title: Understanding Principal Components
text: When looking at a pair of columns, the first principal component is the direction along which the data varies the most. Think about which axis shows the greatest spread of data points.

title: Visualizing Data Spread
text: Consider how the data points are distributed in each plot. The principal component will align with the axis that has the most variation in data points. Which plot shows a vertical spread?

title: Identifying the Principal Component
text: Which pair of columns shows the data points spread more along the vertical axis?
